general_explanation.CQF_mechanism: Cyclic Queuing and Forwarding (CQF) uses two queues that alternate every cycle. While one queue transmits, the other receives. This ensures bounded delay.
general_explanation.WCD_formula_explanation: The WCD formula accounts for: (1) Initial transmission time of the full frame, (2) CQF cycle delays at intermediate switches (each switch except the last may hold the frame for up to one cycle), (3) Propagation delays on all links, (4) Switching delays at all switches, (5) Time synchronization error, (6) Subtraction of one cycle to account for pipelining, (7) Final transmission time at the last hop (cut-through allows partial transmission).
general_explanation.frame_overhead: Each frame includes: Preamble (7B) + SFD (1B) + Dest MAC (6B) + Src MAC (6B) + VLAN tag (4B) + EtherType (2B) + CRC (4B) + IFG (12B) = 42B overhead. Total = Payload + 42B. For minimum frame size, padding may be added.
general_explanation.cut_through_switching: Cut-through switches begin forwarding as soon as the destination address is read. The last hop transmission time is calculated based on the remaining frame portion.
